avis.titre: Not for acne prone skin! Comedogenic and causes irritation.
avis.texte: I don't consider myself to have sensitive skin- acne prone, yes, but not sensitive. I can throw everything but the kitchen sink at my skin when it comes to exfoliating and my skin takes it beautifully. I used this product daily for about a month and started to see some irritation. Thought it was maybe the change in seasons or my other actives. I cut back on those products and the irritation got worse. Started to look like a rash / dermatitis thats caused by heavy moisturizers. Didnt even think thats it was the sunscreen until it was literally the only "new" product on my face. Went back to look at the product more closely. Contains coconut oil, which as an acne prone girly, I know this is very comedogenic / clogs pores / causes dermatitis. Sad because I liked everything else about the product- price, packaging, consistency, absorption, efficacy. Just doesn't work for my skin. 😞

It is low cost and doesn't run when I sweat, high spf.very light and doesn't breakout my face , reef safe. Doesn't make my skin feel greasy and mild scent

Good product for dry skin. I have dry skin during the colder days and this actually works perfect for my face. I recommend for the girlies with dry skin.

avis.titre: Airy, no white cast and no sunscren smell

Second, I love that there is no sunscreen smell (the reason why I avoided lots of chemical sunscreens in the first place). It absorbs very quickly and there is no white cast, leaving an airy feeling, so definitely works great on top of makeup. Third, the package is easy to use, the pump is messy-free and pump a small enough amount to be able to spread all over - I used 4 pumps for my entire face. It is small enough to fit in the pocket of my winter jackets so very great for reapplying. Overall, I really enjoyed this product and would repurchase

avis.titre: Sum Bum daily SPF 50 face lotion
avis.texte: Sun Bum daily SPF face lotion feels so lightweight for a moisturizer. it protects your face against the sun. So if your outside this is great for you because it also helps to prevent in getting sunburns as well. The consistency is kinda watery but glides on smooth. A pump or two goes a long ways. it doesn't have a smell like most sun lotions it's frequency free. It has vitamin e which I love when out in the sun for my skin. The best part is it's water and sweat resistant.

"SPF Moisturizer is a daily part of my morning routine, so I was excited to give a new one a try. My go-to is Too Faced HangoveRx, so my review is in comparison to that product. SunBum off the bat was a decent product to me since it didn't have that strong sunscreen smell so many SPF products do, and it's not really scented in any way. The cream is thin and easy to apply, similar in consistency (perhaps a bit thinner) that Too Faced. I haven't had any irritation or negative reactions to this product, however it does feel like I have a product on my face (ie it doesn't feel like it absorbs in as thoroughly as Too Faced). So for that it gets 4 stars instead of 5."

If those two things don't bother you, I would recommend this product.
